sections.title: Identity marks
sections.description: Proposed guidance for the exact selected emblem and horizontal lockup.

rules.instruction: Keep the selected SVG artboards intact; use the proposed clear-space and digital-size guidance for the matching master.
rules.rationale: Preserve the reviewed artwork and make any new layout guidance explicit.
details: Keep the complete SVG artboard uncropped. Leave clear space on every side equal to at least one eighth of the displayed artboard height (64 SVG units at the original 512-unit height).

Recommended digital width: 64 CSS pixels for the full-detail emblem. Review smaller instances in their actual context or select a separately reviewed small-icon variant. This display guidance adds no condition to the logo-use permission.
Keep the complete SVG artboard uncropped. Leave clear space on every side equal to at least one eighth of the displayed artboard height (50 SVG units at the original 400-unit height).

Recommended digital width: 600 CSS pixels for the complete lockup, retaining the existing tagline. At that width its 28-unit tagline is 14 CSS pixels high before font-specific metrics. Use the standalone emblem in narrower layouts; review smaller lockup instances in their actual context. This is not a legibility, contrast or WCAG guarantee and adds no condition to the logo-use permission.
